label: DHT11 / DHT22 (Temperature/Humidity)
notes: DHT11 or DHT22 single-wire digital temperature and humidity sensor on one data pin.
declarations: declare function dht_read_temperature(pin: number, sensorType: number): number;
declare function dht_read_humidity(pin: number, sensorType: number): number;

actions.notes: Reads the temperature in degrees Celsius into a new float variable; the sensor type (DHT11 or DHT22) must match the hardware.
actions.label: Read temperature (°C)

actions.notes: Reads relative humidity in percent into a new float variable; the sensor type (DHT11 or DHT22) must match the hardware.
actions.label: Read humidity (%RH)
